about: What each failing harness version contract item means to a user, read by scripts/gen-matrix.mjs for the harness checks in Copy diagnostics (Settings → About), for support. Key: the item key from tests/conformance/results/contract/*.json (conformance:X4, edge:codex:checkout), or a scenario on any cell (edge:tls). says: one plain sentence, no CM row ids or probe output. issue: the open issue that tracks it; fixedBy: the pull request that fixed it (the text then says the version waits for a re-check). A failing item without an entry stops the generator.

conformance:X4.says: Codex wrote a trust entry for the chat's folder into its config.toml.

conformance:X7.says: The model misread one letter of a test image; the check was too strict and now allows it.

conformance:X16.says: This version stops a running command when Codex stops; the check expected the older behavior and now accepts both.

edge:crash.says: After an in-app browser tab crashed, the agent waited instead of reloading it.

edge:tls.says: On a page with an untrusted certificate, "Open in your browser" didn't visibly do anything.

edge:deep-link.says: The agent said the in-app browser can't open the Zoom app, but the check missed it because of a curly apostrophe; the check now reads it.

mgb:switch:f2-onboarding.says: In a chat that switched from Claude Code to Codex, the onboarding task did not file the signed copy under the folder's naming pattern with its confirmation number.
